subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

He lost the golden opportunity due to his habit of __procrastination__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Indecisiveness**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Procrastination **means delaying or postponing something. (किसी बात को टालना)

 
 
• **Example**: *His procrastination led to a last-minute rush to complete the project.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Indecisiveness **means the inability to make decisions quickly or efficiently. (जल्दी या कुशलता से निर्णय लेने में असमर्थता)
 
 
• **Example**: *Her indecisiveness made it challenging to finalize plans for the weekend.*
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that the person missed a good opportunity because of their habit of delaying things or not taking prompt actions.

Therefore, **option 1** is the most appropriate synonym for "procrastination" in this context.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Impulsiveness **means acting or deciding without thinking or planning ahead. (बिना सोचे-समझे या आगे की योजना बनाए कार्य करना या निर्णय लेना)
 
• **Inquisitiveness **means having a strong desire to learn or know about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में जानने या सीखने की तीव्र इच्छा होना)
 
• **Submissiveness **means being obedient or willing to yield to authority or control of others. (आज्ञाकारी होना या दूसरों के अधिकार या नियंत्रण के आगे झुकने को तैयार होना)
